grid.endpoints: Both original domain endpoints included; no ghost nodes.

finite_instance.numeric_convention: Original literal constants and exact rational coordinate recipes determine input values. Convert scalar/grid/limiter input leaves once to nearest binary64, ties to even; construct each node psi by the original formula interpreted as a real expression in those constants/coordinates and round the final node leaf once. pi is the mathematical constant used by angular sampling. Subsequent finite algorithms operate on these inputs; no bitwise cross-platform solver equality or numerical tolerance is added.

limiter.closure: Last vertex is an exact copy of the first; consecutive four segments form the closed polygon.
limiter.domain_rule: Every limiter vertex and segment is strictly inside original rectangular domain; original axis lies strictly inside polygon.
limiter.refinement: For every segment, include its intersections with grid lines and its ending vertex, preserving the exact lower-cell/segment order in model.md; no arbitrary extra limiter sampling parameter.
limiter.mask_rule: Closed polygon Path.contains_points with radius0 on grid nodes; general boundary-point ambiguity is not extended to boundary O candidates. The supported finite case uses an interior main O candidate; strict core psi comparison excludes first-contact wall nodes.
limiter.first_contact_rule: current_sign=+1. Bilinearly interpolate node psi on all refined limiter points and take their signed maximum, as defined in model.md.

critical_point_options.candidate_stencil: Strict eight-neighbor minimum of central-difference squared-gradient proxy, with boundary proxy0.
critical_point_options.primary_O_order: Increasing squared distance to original domain center; no new tie breaker.
critical_point_options.ties_or_degenerate_candidates: Outside supported normal limited case; retain original HOLD conditions, never fabricate a chosen point or repair determinant.

boundary_trace.composition: New explicit finite sampling composition of an existing single-ray flux-surface mathematical primitive; not an assertion that an existing high-level empty-X wrapper is executable.
boundary_trace.normalized_flux: q=(psi-psi_A)/(psi_B-psi_A), using actual primary O candidate psi_A and actual limited boundary psi_B, not analytic prefilled answers.

spline.boundary_condition: tensor-product cubic interpolating spline with not-a-knot endpoint constraints (RectBivariateSpline convention)

boundary_trace.theta_recipe: theta_k=2*pi*k/80, k=0,...,79; theta increases from+Z toward+R.
boundary_trace.clip_order: R first, then Z, preserving ray direction, exactly as model.md; each clipping axis is used only when its current absolute ray displacement exceeds1e-6m.
boundary_trace.crossing_rule: First strict q_l>1; interpolate between that sample and its immediately preceding sample. No nonlinear root solve.
boundary_trace.closure: Return80 ordered R/Z crossings then append an exact copy of point0, giving81x2. No X coordinates appended.
boundary_trace.failure_domain: Require finite nonzero normalization, first strict crossing index in1..999 and a finite nonzero adjacent flux difference. Otherwise explicit failure, not null or raw all-false argmax index0. This is the new composition contract, not a changed source kernel.

original_scope_residuals.boundary: No synthetic saddle, SOL leg or strike point is introduced into original quadratic input.

original_scope_residuals.condition: degenerate Hessian detH==0 and undefined critical correction
original_scope_residuals.boundary: No determinant floor, perturbation or replacement axis; existing held cases unchanged.
